questions.skill: Compare two functions represented in different ways
questions.prompt: Function A is y = 0.5x + 10. Function B is a line through (0, 4) and (2, 8). Which statement is true?
questions.prompt_markup:
Function A is y = 0.5x + 10. Function B is a line through (0, 4) and (2, 8).

choices.text: B has the greater rate of change; A has the greater initial value.
B has the greater rate of change and the greater initial value.
A has the greater rate of change and the greater initial value.
They have the same rate of change.

questions.correct_answer: B has the greater rate of change; A has the greater initial value.

sections.skill: Compare average rates of change of linear and nonlinear functions over intervals

questions.skill: Compare average rates of change of linear and nonlinear functions over intervals
questions.standard_level: High school (Common Core high-school standard; this bank places it at Grade 9 as a first forward step. This is an instructional choice, not an official grade assignment.)
questions.prompt: f(x) = x². The table shows g. Find the average rate of change of each function from x = 0 to x = 3.
questions.prompt_markup:
f(x) = x². The table shows g.
Find the average rate of change of each function from x = 0 to x = 3.
questions.correct_answer: Both are 3: f goes from 0 to 9 and g goes from 0 to 9 over 3 units.

questions.skill: Compare average rates of change of linear and nonlinear functions over intervals
questions.standard_level: High school (Common Core high-school standard; this bank places it at Grade 9 as a first forward step. This is an instructional choice, not an official grade assignment.)
questions.prompt: f(x) = 2^x and g(x) = 3x + 5. Find the average rate of change of each function from x = 0 to x = 4. Which is greater?
questions.prompt_markup:
f(x) = 2^x and g(x) = 3x + 5.
Find the average rate of change of each function from x = 0 to x = 4. Which is greater?
questions.correct_answer: f: (16 - 1) ÷ 4 = 3.75; g: 3. f has the greater average rate of change.
questions.grading_note: Both rates and the comparison are required.
